'''Cadriell''' was the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Achillea]], a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Cadriaan Province]] of the [[Tapani sector/Legends|Tapani sector]]. The city was located on a peninsula along the western coast of the [[Planet/Legends|planet's]] northernmost continent, surrounded by cliffs overlooking the [[Ocean/Legends|ocean]].<ref name="Player's Guide" /> The city was protected by several [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] bases on those cliffs, maintained by the planet's owners [[House Cadriaan]]. The city also hosted the [[Achillea Great Market]], the largest market in the [[Sector/Legends|sector]], where all matter of legal merchandise was available for sale. The market was popular with tourists and was busy every [[Standard day/Legends|day]] of the [[Tapani calendar]], except holidays.<ref name="LotE" />

==Behind the scenes==
Cadriell was first mentioned in ''[[Player's Guide to Tapani]]'', a supplement for ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'' written by [[Paul Sudlow]] and [[Eric S. Trautmann]]<ref name="Player's Guide" /> and published in [[June]] [[1997]].<ref name="Release date">{{CargoBay|url=item-detail/7801|text=Player's Guide to Tapani}}</ref>
